author: [AEP]Rhododendron
content: I think that this could have been handled better, the transition from unlimited liquidity/availability of R4 , to a situation where this is no longer the case.  I personally, am in a beneficial situation, because I already had more than enough claimstakes to supply my fleet fully.  Still, this was done with zero notice..... why?  Someone could have bought, for example, the entire ecosystem's "30-day" supply of toolkits that were lumped onto the market at the last available at the DAO price, at about $11,000 if my math is correct.  A lot of people did a portion of this, as could be expected, as that is what has been incentivized.  Now that people have made decisions and committed funds based on this, a further mistake at this point, would be for the ATMTA team to make a significant change to this.  A suggestion..... instead of massive modifications to the economic system, with zero notice, smaller changes could be made, with several days or even a whole week's notice.  For example, in many time zones of our planet, people had zero notice of the 30-day supply being placed as the last available at DAO prices, and when they woke up in the morning, the majority of it, or all of it in some categories, was completely gone.

I'm also 1000% on board with @⪛⦿⫺ZeSKK .  The most important way to combat automation is to make a game that has sufficient depth/complexity. author: 🅰🅲🅴🅺🅸🅽🅶MUD
content:
Question: I want to be self sufficient in Claim Stakes to generate R4 resources to supply my fleet. How to Calculate?

Step 1: go to https://explorer.staratlas.club/ enter your Solana address

Step 2: navigate to Fleet tab click on the red Fleet Consumption button & it automatically calculates all your daily R4 needs

Step 3: go to https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1mwm3cUTHboQVZAzFnt73apIhxhGMozfspBGpeVKe8wE & save your own copy. Paste your Fleet consumption into the green cells. In this example one Pearce C11 and C9 requires 75,253 units of food daily

Step 4: Paste the Claim Stakes you own or want to buy & it will auto populate. In this example a Tier4 & four Tier2 just about covers the R4 needs.

Step 5: In this example there is 50,329 units of excess Food units but not enough fuel.  Purchase what you need in marketplace, grind EscapeVelocity, or

Step 6: ...Barter with your Guild buddies (attached a "fair price" barter table based on the original SA DAO R4 costs).

author: JayWalk
content: Just to explain the security precautions (how to store the seed phrase, how to identify scams and burn it, not download pirated programs/files, etc) it's already between 5m to 10m depending on the level of detail. author: [AEP]Rhododendron
content: Starfield, the space based video game from Bethesda Labs, has to my information ( which is imperfect! ), recently announced that their game will release ( in full ) , this September.  It has taken them many years to develop this game, and it looks fantastic with over 1000 planets to explore in full.  One thing though, and I actually caught myself thinking this by watching the over one-hour long trailer on their website .... "This is an awesome game, I know right now I will buy and play it .... but .... I will own nothing in or from any of the hours that I play in and invest, in this game, so why would I do that?"  Two last thoughts..... I bet they wish that they had incorporated NFTs/decentralization and ownership by players in a legal fashion...... and .... their idea is so similar to that of Star Atlas, I wonder not  "if", rather, how much these two companies have met to speak about integrating some or all of SA into SF.  I have zero inside info on any of this, and have no clue if any discussions have taken place between them.  If SA launches, in my opinion just about every player of SF will be primed by that game, to be  a core part of SA's total addressable market.

content: I also really feel like the racers are under powered.  I've only raced the X4, Airbike, and Solos, and it is super fun, but too sedate.  I liken the X4 and Airbike to motorcycles in the real world, and if I go full throttle, it should hit hard and be impossible to maintain control in those turns. The Solos maybe are closer to the right feel- it rides much smoother and stable, and I could see it trading raw power for traction and stability.

author: Xcode [STAR]
content:
Take this with a grain of salt, it's still a WIP

The top level item is your Account
Below that are linked wallets (like your phantom or ledger which manages your assets and your PVP). 

Below that (associated to each wallet) are multiple player profiles, each one with its own account progression. This is where your faction selection happens and these profiles can be traded on the open market.

author: ! SH | Bohemian ⪛⦿⫺
content:
⁠archived-foundation-room⁠As far as I can remember (town hall meeting in the Summer of 2021) there was always the intention to afford some power to the player engaging long hours with the metaverse.  These players' engagement help maintain the SA ecosystem and should be partially rewarded with a voice in Regional & Local Politics... higher at Local & strong at Planetary levels.
I like the idea that Active players with little POLIS can leverage their gaming efforts with a stipend to their political influence.
If players with abundant POLIS want the same leverage, the option is open to them too IF they engage at the same level as other players. 

Personally, I believe this system levels the playing field a bit, without taking too much from the Strong POLIS holders that won't be too active or are totally passive in the day-to-day game loops.  Overall, strong POLIS holders will still wield considerable political power at DAOs, especially in the SA DAO while receiving appropriate emissions (and Reward Distributions by approved PIPs) for their long term POLIS investment.

**These are my personal views.

author: [AEP]Rhododendron
content: To the extent that " playing time " is rewarded with Polis Voting Power, it not the " person's playing time" that is being rewarded the most .... Bots have the most playing time by far, as in 24 hours per day versus maybe 12 per day max by a "human player", in reality most humans also have a life to live so approximately 3 hours per day on average if you are a fanatic about the game, so this rewards bots at about 8x the rate of "the devoted human player" playing 21 hours per week.

-- Possible Multi-Faction System -- 
One Player Account  (NOT Tradable)

        \_ **Profile(s)  (initially one, later multiple per wallet) - Profiles are Tradable - Have Progression Level

                    \_ ***Races/Species Selection per Profile

* Can only use one wallet at a time.
** Each Profile can join different or the same DAC
*** Faction agnostic

author: ! SH | Bohemian ⪛⦿⫺
content:
Possible Implementations For Crew Members in SAGE

1. Crew Members (crew cards) will be purchasable & tradeable from/on the Marketplace.
2. Crew Members can be brought in as crew and positioned in CSS or SS.
3. Crew Members can be bought separately and independently from ships. 
4. There are no restrictions on the number of Crew Members occupying a CSS or SS. 
5. Crew Members will begin with zero experience and acquire expertise/XP on the skills necessary to perform a given activity. 
6. Crew Members will have a Skill Tree Progression System, and their skills will advance based on the crew member’s experience (XP) gained by spending time performing given activities.
7. All GAO Ships will come with FREE crew members (if GAO ship is owned at snapshot time)

NOTES:
~ A version of the Player Profile System could arrive next SAGE version. 
~ The application of the Crew Progression System might initially be account-wide without individual crew progression. 
~ Council Rank does not affect the number of crew members a player can have at CSS/SS.
